<rule id="sysctl_net_core_bpf_jit_harden">
  <description>Set net.core.bpf_jit_harden to 2 and make it persistent</description>
  <condition>
    <check>
      <check_expression xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
        <![CDATA[
          function="local" 
          object="/proc/sys/net/core/bpf_jit_harden" 
          condition="not equals" 
          value="2"
        ]]>
      </check>
    </condition>
    <if>
      <then>
        <write_file path="/proc/sys/net/core/bpf_jit_harden">
          <value>2</value>
        </write_file>
        <run_cmd command="/bin/sh -c 'echo 2 >> /etc/sysctl.d/99-sysctl.conf'">
        </run_cmd>
      </then>
    </if>
</rule>
